settings.content: Show/hide: open each homepage section and use “Show this section”. Reorder: Customize → Home page → drag sections in the left sidebar. Header and footer stay in their groups.
Hero, Size + reserve, FAQ, lifestyle collage, and the other landing sections all support show/hide.
Brand name (only place to edit)
These two fields are the only place to set the store name. Header wordmark, footer wordmark, Trading as, contact, and share meta all read from here. Change the name without uploading a logo.

settings.label: Brand name (line 1)
settings.info: Line 1 of the header and footer wordmark, plus [Brand] copy tokens. Trading as uses this plus Product line on one plain line.

settings.label: Product line (line 2)
settings.info: Line 2 of the header and footer wordmark (e.g. Mattresses or The Mattress). Trading as and contact append this on the same line (e.g. Numa Mattresses). Leave blank to hide line 2.

settings.label: Legal name
settings.info: Registered company on Privacy, Terms, Cookies, checkout terms, and copyright. Not the wordmark. Trading as still uses Brand name and Product line. UK can override under Business details.

settings.label: Company number
settings.info: Shown on Privacy, Terms, Cookies, contact, and the footer when filled. Leave blank to hide the row. UK can override under Business details → Company number (UK).

settings.content: Brand guidelines

V1 is the live Numa system: deep navy, cream/beige grounds, gold wordmark and eyebrows on light. On navy/dark sections, body and headings stay cream. V2 carbon/snow is optional, not the storefront default.
Colour palette
V1 schemes: Signature, Classic navy, Warm charcoal, Cool graphite. V2 schemes: Carbon+Ember, Graphite+Ember, Warm bone, Cool steel.

options.label: V1 · Signature - gold wordmark, ink headlines
V1 · Classic navy - navy wordmark & headlines

settings.label: Primary (navy / charcoal)
settings.info: Used for CTAs and dark sections. Warm charcoal / cool graphite schemes override this.

settings.content: Typography
Type is locked to the brand guidelines: Instrument Sans (headings / wordmark), Inter (body), Geist Mono (labels). Theme font-set controls below are unused.

settings.label: Font set (unused — locked to guidelines)

options.label: Brand — Instrument Sans / Inter / Geist Mono
Brand — Instrument Sans / Inter / Geist Mono

settings.info: Live storefront always loads Instrument Sans, Inter and Geist Mono. Do not mix serif.

settings.content: Advanced overrides below only apply when Font set is Modern.
CTA shape

Corner radius for every storefront CTA: header, hero, size-card Add, basket, line/ghost/quiet, and dark-on-navy. Curved is 2px (a milled edge, not a rounded pill). Square is 0. Size cards stay square.

settings.label: CTA shape
settings.info: Curved = 2px radius, 4px focus offset. Square = 0 radius, 3px focus offset. Matches the radius comparison spec.

settings.content: The storefront follows the visitor’s Shopify / browser country (UK, UAE, US, Europe). Unlisted countries use the UK. Prefer Shopify Markets for currency. Shoppers do not switch country tabs.

settings.label: Default market
settings.info: Used only when Shopify has no country (and for legacy fallbacks). Live pages resolve GB / AE / US / EU from localization.country and otherwise use the UK.

settings.label: Size Add button
settings.info: Label on each available size in Size + price + reserve.

settings.label: Payment mode
settings.info: Full = 100% at checkout (current). Split = first payment now, balance before dispatch. One setting drives all copy and checkout behaviour.

settings.label: First payment percentage
settings.info: Used when Payment mode is Split. Product price in Shopify must match the amount charged today.

settings.label: Split first-payment label
settings.info: Only used in Split mode (amount due today). Use £50 for UK if that is your first payment.

settings.label: Klarna client ID
settings.info: From your Klarna merchant portal. Leave blank to disable Klarna messaging. Loads only for the UK market.

settings.label: Splitit available
settings.info: Off at launch. Turn on once the merchant account is approved and tested. Also requires a Splitit merchant ID. UK only.

settings.label: Splitit merchant ID
settings.info: Terminal Id from Splitit Hub (Merchants Management → Terminals). Leave blank to disable regardless of the checkbox.

settings.label: BNPL extra line (optional)
settings.info: Do not put a monthly figure, term length or APR. Klarna and Tabby/Tamara render their own terms.

settings.label: Comfort layer lead time - min weeks
Comfort layer lead time - max weeks
Made-to-order lead time (deprecated)
settings.info: Deprecated. Use the min/max week numbers above. Kept until every reference is migrated. Templates must not read this.

settings.default: Made to order. Current window: [lead]. Cancel any time before dispatch for a full refund.

settings.info: How long Adjust to Desire runs from delivery. 12 renders as a year in body copy.

settings.info: Named replacement-layer value on landing pages ([layer]). Matches the live store figure. Leave blank to use the comfort layer product price when that product exists.

settings.label: Comfort layer price (AE)
settings.info: Named replacement-layer value on landing pages ([layer]) for UAE. Leave blank to use the comfort layer product price when that product exists.

settings.default: Made to order, so natural variation in fabric shade is possible. The construction is identical every time.

settings.label: Comfort layer available to buy
settings.info: Off at launch. When off, the comfort layer page is absent - no link, no sitemap entry, cart rejects the item. Keep the product draft so it 404s. Handle: comfort-layer.

settings.label: Pillows available to buy

settings.info: Independent of the three product flags. When on, the footer lists only the products whose own flags are also on. No shop link in the main navigation.

settings.info: Off until verified. Gates trust bar, specs strip, offer, and FAQ items for this claim.

settings.label: Show OEKO-TEX® STANDARD 100 claim
settings.info: Off until a certificate number is verified. The claim still will not render unless the certificate number below is filled.

settings.label: OEKO-TEX certificate number
settings.info: Displayed next to the OEKO-TEX claim. Required. Leave blank to hide the claim even if the toggle above is on.

settings.content: Prefer Google Tag Manager. Theme code pushes events to dataLayer via vTrack (lp_view, configure_start, configure_complete, add_to_basket, add_service, basket_view, begin_checkout, purchase, plus scroll_depth, scroll_past_price, engaged_session). Every event carries lp_variant and session_id. Meta and GA4 are configured in GTM only — no direct theme scripts. Map add_to_basket as the primary conversion.

settings.label: Google Tag Manager container ID
settings.info: Paste the container ID (GTM-XXXXXXX). Leave blank to disable.

settings.label: Google Ads tag ID (configure in GTM)
TikTok Pixel ID (legacy if no GTM)
Snapchat Pixel ID (legacy if no GTM)
Microsoft Clarity project ID (legacy if no GTM; prefer GTM)
settings.info: Session recordings for low-sample diagnosis.

settings.content: Exit-intent prompt

Optional single-question popup on leave (desktop mouseleave) or rapid scroll-up (mobile). Answers are stored in the browser, sent as cart attributes (exit_intent_reason) for Shopify order export, and fired as a vTrack event.

settings.label: Enable exit-intent prompt
settings.info: Off by default. Turn on for paid-test diagnosis.

settings.label: Wait before prompt can appear
settings.info: Seconds on the page before leave/scroll-up can show the prompt.

settings.label: Show Numa-written review pack
settings.info: Turns off the 500 seed reviews we wrote. Customer reviews still show. Does not hide the Social proof section — use Customize → Social proof → Show this section for that.

settings.label: Allow customers to leave reviews
settings.info: Shows a write-a-review form. Submissions are emailed to you for moderation before publishing.

settings.label: Only buyers can review
settings.info: Requires a signed-in customer with at least one order (including a deposit purchase).

settings.content: Approved customer reviews: add them to the reviews.json theme asset with source "customer" (or omit source). The Numa-written pack is tagged source "seed". Or connect a reviews app block in Social proof.

These fields power the footer, contact page, Privacy, Terms, Cookies, and the legal line. Legal name, company number, and registered address also live under Brand. Edit here in Theme settings (not in the footer section).
Contact

settings.label: Contact email
settings.info: Shown in the footer and contact page.

settings.label: Trade and contract enquiries email
settings.info: Shown on the Trade page and used for all bulk order enquiries. If empty, both mailto links fall back to the contact page.

settings.content: Phone and WhatsApp are set per country under UAE / UK below. The storefront uses the visitor’s market (or Default market).
Contact hours

Type the clock times only (for example 9:00-17:00). You can include days (Mon-Fri) if you want. Do not type GST, BST, or GMT - the theme adds the right abbreviation for that country, and it changes with summer time where that applies.

settings.label: Hours (UK)
settings.info: United Kingdom (GB) only. Time zone is BST in summer and GMT after the clocks change.

settings.label: Hours (UAE)
settings.info: United Arab Emirates (AE). Time zone is GST (no summer time).

settings.label: Hours (USA)
settings.info: United States (US). Abbreviation follows the USA time zone setting below (Eastern by default: EDT / EST).

settings.label: USA time zone (abbreviation only)
settings.info: Does not change the clock times you typed. Only picks EST/EDT, CST/CDT, MST/MDT, or PST/PDT.

settings.label: Hours (Europe, including Albania)
settings.info: EU, EEA, Switzerland, and nearby European countries including Albania (AL). Not the UK. Time zone is CEST in summer and CET in winter.

settings.label: Hours (Ghana)
settings.info: Ghana (GH). Time zone is GMT (no summer time).

settings.label: Hours (Nigeria)
settings.info: Nigeria (NG). Time zone is WAT (no summer time).

settings.info: Used when the visitor country is not UK, UAE, USA, Europe, Ghana, or Nigeria, or if that market field is blank. Time zone follows Default market.
